verdict.rationale: GrowthBook publishes a pricing page with tiers. The free tier is bounded by users (up to 3) and projects (1), while feature flags, experiments and traffic are explicitly unlimited, which implies seats rather than MAUs, events or requests drive cost. Feature differences across tiers are also listed. However, the evidence shows no actual price amounts or per-seat rates, so a PM cannot fully work out cost before committing. Missing for 10: published dollar prices per tier/seat, an explicit statement of the billing unit for paid tiers, and independent corroboration of the cost model.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can see published pricing and understand what drives cost (seats, MAUs, events, requests) before committing
